summary: Quiet residential kerb with cars parked, but homes 11-18 m away on both sides.

best_section.where: Seventh Avenue south kerb, mid-block between the corner and the dead-end bend

drivers.seclusion: Dense housing: detached homes 11 m south and 14-18 m north of the best section; no bush or park buffer.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars parked along the kerb, so room to stop exists.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, light local traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the kerb, but signs give 2P Mon-Fri 7am-6pm, resident permits excepted; overnight is outside those hours.

flags: Slightly steep: about 3% grade at best section
sun_shade: Mixed tree canopy over the south kerb, mostly shaded from the west and south.
